subject: app-rdef
title: (R)APP.RDEF.------T.C.IMP.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 107 (T(AF)M-11). APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. From the subject: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From POL-DYM: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). From PROJ-CONT: INFO-DY (information dynamics), ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and RT-T. From INFO-DY: RE-DIF (redefinitions), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From RT-T: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From RT-INT-TR: RE-ST (restructuralism), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
